_comment: Which applications columns the browser may UPDATE, and which the server owns.
public.applications no longer grants table-wide UPDATE to `authenticated`; it
grants an explicit column list. That is default-closed, which is what we want,
but it means a column added to the table is silently NOT editable from the
admin UI until somebody extends the grant — and the symptom is a bare
serverOwned is the intent. Everything else on the table is expected to be
browser-editable. scripts/grants.test.mjs compares this to reality.
